caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden cupboard with a natural light brown finish. The cupboard consists of two main sections: an upper section and a lower section. The upper section features two vertical doors, one wider than the other, with simple geometric borders and a small circular knob on each door, one with a visible hinge on the left side. The lower section contains three large horizontal drawers, each equipped with two small round knobs, and there is one smaller drawer directly beneath the upper section that also has a pair of round knobs. The wood grain is visible throughout, and the cupboard has a flat top and a slightly protruding base. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background and is labeled "Sill Cupboard" at the bottom in light gray text. There is an artist's signature in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Sill Cupboard
